correctness.rationale: The rooted-forest marginal is a weighted spanning-tree law on the wheel with conductance q spokes. Matrix-tree differentiation yields determinantal rim-edge kernel K=L(qI+L)^(-1)=I-qG and probability covariance C_ij=K_ii delta_ij - K_ij^2. The periodized one-dimensional Green function G_d=(t^d+t^(n-d))/(sqrt(q(q+4))(1-t^n)) gives the stated exact Fourier eigenvalues, with the extra constant-mode cross term. The nonzero-mode denominator increases in angular separation, while the constant-mode cross term makes sigma0 strictly minimal. Positive probability of empty and singleton edge sets proves C positive definite; most alternating harmonics maximize. Exact n-dependent formulas imply fixed q limiting ratio (1+t)^2/(1+t^2), q~c/n^2 profile 2sinh(sqrt(c))/(sinh(sqrt(c))-sqrt(c)), small mass ratio 12/(n^2 q), and large n^2 q with q->0 ratio 2. Checked wheel component coefficients c_n1=n^2,c_n2=n^2(n^2-1)/12, and the asymptotic scale. Independently enumerated rooted cycle forest weights and rational covariance rows for n=3..8 at rational q, checked Fourier formulas, positivity and extrema numerically with controlled tolerance. Finite tests supplement the all-n resolvent proof.
